message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges based on facts. The facts: Stone (石某) went to hotel front desk, pretended to book a room, chatted, then at 11:50 he pretended to check in, asked staff to get water, while staff distracted, he stole cash 9400 yuan from front desk. This is theft (盗窃). Possibly also robbery? The difference: robbery (抢劫) involves use of violence or threat to obtain property. Here he used deception and took cash while staff were present but not using force. He used deception and maybe intimidation? He pretended to be a guest, but didn't threaten. So it's theft, not robbery. Also maybe "抢夺" (snatching) but not listed. The co-occurrence summary shows "盗窃" co-occurs with 抢劫, 掩饰 etc. But we only have theft. No other crimes like fraud? He pretended to be a guest, but that is deception to obtain property, could be "诈骗" (fraud) if he obtained property by deception. However Chinese law: 诈骗罪 requires obtaining property by false pretenses, causing victim to transfer property. Here he didn't cause the hotel to transfer property; he just took cash that was already there. That's theft. So charge: 盗窃.

Check if there is "抢劫" because he used threat? He didn't threaten. So just theft.

Thus answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>
